# Acumo AI

> Acumo AI is a technical engineering agency building AI-native web products for growth-stage businesses and enterprises — including low-latency Voice AI agents, custom AI chatbots, full-stack SaaS MVPs, and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO). Acumo AI specializes in Next.js architecture, real-time voice pipelines, and technical schema optimization for AI search platforms like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity.

Acumo AI designs and ships production-grade AI systems rather than templated websites or off-the-shelf widgets. Engagements typically start with a scoped technical proposal and move directly into custom engineering.

## Services

- [Voice AI & CRM Systems](https://www.acumoai.com/services/voice-ai-crm): Custom voice agents engineered for inbound/outbound calls with real-time lead qualification, 24/7 calendar booking, and CRM integration (HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Salesforce).
- [Full-Stack MVP Build](https://www.acumoai.com/services/mvp-development): Rapid 0-to-1 web/mobile application builds with scalable backends, modern tech stacks (Next.js, FastAPI, PostgreSQL), and AI integrations.
- [Websites & Booking Engine](https://www.acumoai.com/services/websites-booking): Ultra-fast custom websites with embedded scheduling, payment gateways, and automated client portals built for conversion.
- [Custom AI & Automations](https://www.acumoai.com/services/ai-automation): Custom LLM pipelines, RAG implementations, WhatsApp/SMS bots, and automated business operations.
- [AI Document Processing](https://www.acumoai.com/services/ai-document-processing): Custom AI document processing and data entry automation that extracts data from invoices, purchase orders, quotes and emails and pushes it into ERP, CRM and accounting systems.
- [Codebase Cleanup & Hardening](https://www.acumoai.com/services/codebase-cleanup): Audits, refactors, and hardens AI-generated and vibe-coded applications built in Cursor, Lovable, Bolt.new, or v0 into secure, scalable production software in 1–2 weeks.

- [Free AI Voice Generators vs a Real AI Voice Agent](https://www.acumoai.com/articles/free-ai-voice-generators-vs-a-real-ai-voice-agent): A free AI voice generator makes audio from text. - [What a Voice AI Minute Really Costs in 2026](https://www.acumoai.com/articles/what-voice-ai-minute-really-costs-2026): Vendors quote $0.05 a minute. The real voice AI bill is $0.08 to $0.25 once you add STT, LLM, voice, telephony and concurrency.

## Case Studies

- [Halo Voice AI](https://www.acumoai.com/#case-studies): Full-stack AI voice receptionist and analytics console for healthcare clinics handling 94% of inbound calls autonomously. Stack: Python, FastAPI, LangGraph, React, Postgres, Twilio/VAPI.
- [Murad Sweets](https://www.acumoai.com/#case-studies): Full-stack e-commerce platform with custom box builder and automated pickup/delivery fulfillment. Stack: Next.js, FastAPI, Python, TypeScript, PostgreSQL.
- [Chart Visualizer](https://www.acumoai.com/#case-studies): Agentic natural language data analysis platform converting conversational prompts into charts. Stack: Python, FastAPI, React, Docker, GPT-4o.
- [Policy Viz](https://www.acumoai.com/#case-studies): Grounded policy retrieval system with zero hallucinations. Stack: LangChain, Pinecone, Next.js, TypeScript.
- [Andent Suite](https://www.acumoai.com/#case-studies): Practice management portal for dental clinics with real-time multi-location sync. Stack: React, GraphQL, Node.js, PostgreSQL.
